default_lease_time.description: Default lease duration in seconds for dynamic clients.

max_lease_time.description: Maximum lease duration in seconds for dynamic clients.

dns_update_style.description: Method for updating DNS records (e.g., 'none', 'ad hoc', 'static', 'interim').

use_logging.description: Enable detailed logging of DHCP activity.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., 'daemon', 'local0'–'local7').

domain_name.description: DNS domain name to assign to DHCP clients.

name_servers.description: List of DNS server IP addresses to assign to clients.

subnets.description: List of IPv4 subnets to serve. Each entry defines a network, range, and gateway.

range_start.description: First IP in the dynamic range.

range_end.description: Last IP in the dynamic range.

gateway.description: Default gateway IP for this subnet.

default_lease_time.description: Per-subnet default lease time (overrides global if set).

max_lease_time.description: Per-subnet max lease time (overrides global if set).

options.description: Additional custom DHCP options for this subnet (e.g., {'timezone': '"UTC"', 'ntp-servers': '"0.pool.ntp.org"'}).

hosts.description: List of static host reservations. Each entry binds a MAC address to a fixed IP.

mac.description: Client's MAC address in colon-separated hex (e.g., 'aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff').

options.description: Custom DHCP options for this host (e.g., {'host-name': '"printer1"'}).
